mapper.select: SELECT id, created_by_user_id, scope_user_id, scope_run_id, scope_starts_at, scope_ends_at, enabled, created_at, disabled_at FROM agent_debug_trace_control WHERE enabled = 1 AND disabled_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT id, control_id, user_id, run_id, event_type, content, content_sha256, content_expires_at, content_deleted_at, created_at FROM agent_debug_trace_capture WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_debug_trace_capture SET user_id = #{anonymizedUserId}, content = NULL, content_deleted_at = CASE WHEN content IS NOT NULL THEN #{deletedAt} ELSE content_deleted_at END WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE agent_debug_trace_control SET scope_user_id = #{anonymizedUserId}, enabled = 0, disabled_at = COALESCE(disabled_at, #{deletedAt}) WHERE scope_user_id = #{userId}
